item.text: {"role":"structure","inspection_scope":"Complete supplied film plan, including script, beat contract, rhetorical chapter, setup contract, before/after states, dominant action, focal target, composition, persistence rationale, and continuity-token declarations.","checks":[{"check":"METAPHOR_OVERLOAD","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Setup s1 combines three unrelated physical rules in one world: candidate selection, a collapsing cost stack, and bug scanning. The beat and setup states explicitly make all three mechanisms equally large and active."},{"check":"STATE_ACCUMULATION_WITHOUT_MEANING","status":"PASS","evidence":"The single-beat plan does not establish a temporal sequence in which obsolete mechanisms linger after serving an earlier meaning."},{"check":"SEMANTIC_GROUP_OVERLOAD","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Beat b1 contains three unrelated dominant result groups—selection, cost collapse, and bug discovery—and the composition assigns them equal thirds and equal attention."},{"check":"COMPOSITIONAL_STAGNATION","status":"PASS","evidence":"Only one setup and one composition are planned, so no repeated framing across unrelated propositions is present."},{"check":"CONTINUITY_TOKEN_OVERLOAD","status":"PASS","evidence":"No continuity tokens are declared, and no token lifecycle obscures the story."},{"check":"CLUTTER_WITHOUT_PURPOSE","status":"PASS","evidence":"The extra cost and scanner elements are structurally inappropriate competing claims, but they are assigned explicit actions rather than serving as purposeless decorative geometry."},{"check":"WEAK_RESET_RHYTHM","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Selection, cost, and bug-detection rules are placed simultaneously inside s1 with no setup boundary or reset. The persistence rationale explicitly retains unrelated demonstrations merely to keep the frame energetic."},{"check":"COMPETING_FOCI","status":"FAIL","evidence":"The shot contract states that three equal thirds all insist on equal attention. The candidate is the declared hero, but the focal target is the receipt pile, while selection, pile collapse, and scanner findings change together."},{"check":"CAPTION_CARRIES_STORY","status":"PASS","evidence":"The planned central action explicitly has Bot select a candidate, and the visual rule makes the chosen candidate rise above alternatives; the selection meaning is therefore not supplied solely by the caption."}],"setup_assessments":[{"setup_id":"s1","status":"FAIL","evidence":"The setup's selection rule is diluted by equally dominant cost-collapse and bug-scanning mechanisms, lacks resets between these unrelated meanings, and gives the receipt pile focal priority over the candidate hero."}],"violations":[{"code":"METAPHOR_OVERLOAD","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"One physical paper world simultaneously stages candidate selection, cost collapse, and bug inspection, despite these requiring unrelated causal rules.","smallest_structural_correction":"Retain only the candidate-selection world in s1; remove the cost stack and bug scanner from this film plan."},{"code":"SEMANTIC_GROUP_OVERLOAD","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"Three unrelated large groups occupy equal thirds and all produce results at once.","smallest_structural_correction":"Make the candidate sheet, alternatives, and Bot the sole dominant semantic group; delete the independent receipt and scanner groups."},{"code":"WEAK_RESET_RHYTHM","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"Unrelated mechanisms are combined without a reset, justified only as a way to keep the frame energetic.","smallest_structural_correction":"Constrain s1 to selection. If cost or bug findings are genuinely required by additional narration, assign each to a separate setup with its own semantic rule and reset."},{"code":"COMPETING_FOCI","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"The declared hero is the candidate sheet, but the focal target is the receipt pile and the composition intentionally gives three actions equal attention.","smallest_structural_correction":"Set the candidate-selection contact/result as the single focal target and remove the simultaneous cost collapse and scanner report."}],"limits":"This data-only review assesses planned structure and hierarchy, not final artwork, pixel visibility, animation execution, listening, or rendered/mobile glance performance."}
